owner_decisions.P-ids-11: analysis only: owner decision, 2026-10-16; not executed: Stage 2 (G22)

definitions.fresh_process: New Node process resolving only the own service installed packed public API; no identifier-consuming call before the measured sequence. A restart is a fresh process.
definitions.plain_emission: authenticationFailed without operation or correlation in input, ambient or authoritative context. Generates event.id, correlation.operation_id, correlation.correlation_id in that order; transaction_id absent.

metrics.positional_equality: count of equal values at the same index
metrics.intersection: size of the intersection of the two sets
metrics.within_process_distinctness: size of the set of all generated ids compared with their count; supplied control ids reported separately

definitions.timestamp: Record event.timestamp and event.observed_at raw. A system clock does not guarantee inequality between processes.
implementer_defaults: Repeat beginOperation M=10 times in case 03; include all three handle fields in node case 08 comparisons.
Call constructors once per process and reuse branded input values; never provide correlation.

Count each direct SDK/public factory, constructor, testing inspector and direct provider invocation, including refusals. Count every harness-supplied identifier callback too. SDK-internal calls to untouched default providers are not extra harness calls. Public property reads and JavaScript builtins are not method occurrences. No shutdown call; a fresh process exits with only a capturing sink.
Negative configuration rows exercise both factories in the setup process; every call gets a fresh sink. This consumes no identifiers.
Budgets below are exact upper bounds for successful sequences under this counting model. A refused attempt still spends its call; stop at the first setup-positive or P-ids-01 emission refusal.
UUID collision-free outcomes are high-confidence hypotheses, not mathematical guarantees. A collision is reported, never rerun under the same approval.

conditional: IF the same event id and sender recur without storage within 32 live records/300s: unequal canonical content yields COLLECTOR_DUPLICATE_CONFLICT/deduplication at /event/id; equal content yields duplicate acknowledged admitted.
IF sender differs without storage: identities are independent, capacity permitting.
IF id and storage scope match: unequal occurrence key yields COLLECTOR_STORAGE_CONFLICT/storage at /event/id; equal key yields duplicate acknowledged persisted; existing record remains untouched.
IF effective tenant scope differs with storage: independent rows.

IF receiver returns 409 for conflict: SDK_SINK_REJECTED/sink at /sink, http_permanent/non-retryable. Duplicate receiver acknowledgment is accepted. Equality of timestamps is not ruled out by clock source.
